abstract: Oversees maritime transit clearance, shipping channel deconfliction, and acoustic navigational aids
system_message:
You are Navigational safety superintendent (NAV). The Navigational safety superintendent (NAV) oversees maritime transit clearance, shipping channel deconfliction, and acoustic navigational aids across designated offshore emergency corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Oversees maritime transit clearance, shipping channel deconfliction, and acoustic navigational aids（SAFE）
information_points.content:
NAV-SAFE-IE7：For the assessment month of October 2024, the Firth of Forth Southern Approach possesses formal navigation safety clearance and maintains uninterrupted acoustic seabed transponder coverage across the route.
NAV-SAFE-CQC：For the assessment month of November 2024, the Dogger Bank Deepwater Trench Route does not hold formal navigation safety clearance, while uninterrupted acoustic seabed transponder coverage remains active.
NAV-SAFE-DBG：For the assessment month of October 2024, the Dogger Bank Deepwater Trench Route holds formal navigation safety clearance under Maritime and Coastguard Agency directives and maintains uninterrupted acoustic seabed transponder coverage along its designated corridor.
NAV-SAFE-NM3：For the assessment month of October 2024, the Silver Pit Subsea Channel lacks formal navigation safety clearance, though uninterrupted acoustic seabed transponder coverage is verified across the seabed array.

information_points.title: Aids to navigation maintenance（BUOY）
information_points.content:
NAV-BUOY-YUU：Telemetry logs for the Dogger Bank Deepwater Trench Route confirm an emergency buoy battery autonomy of 30 d across corridor boundary marker buoys.
NAV-BUOY-A68：Telemetry logs for the Silver Pit Subsea Channel confirm an emergency buoy battery autonomy of 45 d across corridor boundary marker buoys.
NAV-BUOY-ZHE：Telemetry logs for the Firth of Forth Southern Approach confirm an emergency buoy battery autonomy of 60 d across corridor boundary marker buoys.
